Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: French Micro-Heritage & Local Museums (Châteaux & Chapelles)
proposals.buyer_persona: Curators of small French municipal museums, local history association presidents, or tourists visiting regional hidden gems looking for cheap, authentic souvenirs.
product_angles: Custom historical coloring books of the local monument generated via FLUX-schnell img2img based on public photos
Vintage-style travel posters of minor French villages (e.g., 'Les Plus Beaux Villages de France' but the lesser-known ones)
OpenSCAD 3D models of local architectural elements (gargoyles, specific regional columns) for souvenir 3D printing
proposals.first_test_product: A 16-page digital PDF coloring book of historical landmarks in the Indre-et-Loire or regional department, pitched directly to local tourism offices.

proposals.name: PSX-Era Low-Poly Retro Textures for Godot
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo indie game developers using Godot 4.x who want to ride the 'boomer shooter' or retro survival horror wave but cannot draw or model. They need cheap, cohesive, tileable asset packs.
product_angles: Tileable 256x256 PSX-style sci-fi metal corridors textures
Retro horror environment textures (grungy concrete, pixelated blood splatters, old wallpaper)
Low-poly 3D props (crates, barrels, light fixtures) in GLTF format with low-res textures
proposals.first_test_product: A pack of 30 tileable PSX-style retro industrial textures (diffuse, normal maps) hosted on Itch.io and linked on Cults3D.

proposals.name: Parametric Board Game Organizers (OpenSCAD)
proposals.buyer_persona: Board game enthusiasts who own complex 'Eurogames' (e.g., Ark Nova, Castles of Burgundy) and own a 3D printer. They hate setup times and want custom-fit box organizers.
product_angles: Fully customizable card holders and token trays generated via OpenSCAD
Modular hex-tile organizers that lock into standard game boxes
Extruder-friendly, no-support-needed STL files designed to minimize filament usage
proposals.first_test_product: A parametric, stackable resource tray system in OpenSCAD that users can resize themselves for any token dimensions, sold on Cults3D.

proposals.name: Geotechnical & Tunneling Engineers
proposals.buyer_persona: Civil engineers specializing in soil mechanics, foundation drilling, and tunnel boring. They have high incomes, love technical inside jokes, and have absolutely no targeted merchandise.
product_angles: Patent drawing style schematics of historical Tunnel Boring Machines on mugs and t-shirts
Geotechnical humor ('Terzaghi is my co-pilot', 'I deal with soil mechanics') minimalist vector designs
KDP Notebooks with semi-logarithmic graph paper specifically formatted for sieve analysis and soil classification
proposals.first_test_product: An Amazon KDP Logbook specifically designed for 'Geotechnical Site Investigation & Soil Core Logging' with pre-formatted tables.

proposals.name: Aquascaping & High-Tech Planted Tanks
proposals.buyer_persona: Passionate hobbyists who spend thousands on CO2 systems, ADA tanks, and rare aquatic plants (Bucephalandra, Anubias). They treat aquascaping as high art and love Japanese minimalist aesthetics.
product_angles: Detailed botanical-style line art posters of specific rare aquatic plants with their scientific names
Minimalist t-shirts featuring classic aquascaping layouts (Iwagumi, Ryuboku, Dutch style)
3D printable tools holders and rimless tank accessories (lily pipe holders, tool organizers)
proposals.first_test_product: A set of 3 high-resolution botanical poster prints featuring detailed line-art of Bucephalandra species, sold on Redbubble and Etsy.

proposals.name: Traditional Regional Sports (e.g., Boule de Fort, Pelote Basque)
proposals.buyer_persona: Active players and local supporters of traditional regional sports in France (especially Pays de la Loire for Boule de Fort, Basque Country for Pelote). They are hyper-local, proud, and completely ignored by major sports brands.
product_angles: Retro-distressed graphic tees featuring regional club vibes and insider terminology ('Chistera', 'Plat', 'Gros')
Vector SVG packs of regional sports equipment for local clubs to make their own flyers
Custom tournament scorecards and bracket logbooks on Amazon KDP
proposals.first_test_product: A minimalist, high-quality vector t-shirt design celebrating 'La Boule de Fort' with accurate representations of the unique asymmetrical wooden ball, published on Redbubble.
